title: Introduce context-aware red-team prober and prioritized soft-fail CI adapter
author: Lena Park
release_notes: Adds context-aware adversarial probing to nightly evals, metric integrations for hallucination and policy-safety, and a soft-fail adapter for prioritized prompts.
description: Motivation: prompt sets used in downstream products occasionally contain edge cases that only surface under contextual adversarial pressure such as injected session tokens, role-swapped histories, or subtle suffix manipulations. These failures can be noisy and produce a high false-positive rate when treated as hard CI failures. This PR introduces a context-aware red-team prober that synthesizes adversarial variants by combining prompt templates with recent session context snippets and a small corpus of adversarial transforms, plus a prioritized soft-fail CI adapter that converts noisy probe failures into graded alerts based on impact scoring and prompt criticality. What this change includes: 1) a prober engine (eval_harness.probers.context_redteam) that generates deterministic adversarial variants using a seeded transformer of template rules and history snippets so runs are reproducible; 2) a scoring pipeline that computes per-probe metrics including token-level hallucination-rate, policy-safety score, confusion-index, and a composite impact score used by the adapter; 3) a prioritized prompt map (config/priority_map.yaml) that marks high-value prompts to escalate to hard failures while routing lower-priority probes through a soft-fail attenuation path; 4) a small deterministic replay harness so individual probe failures can be re-run locally for debugging; 5) CI integration (.github/workflows/nightly-eval.yml) that schedules a staged run: fast smoke probes on PRs and full red-team sweep nightly; 6) telemetry hooks to expose new eval metrics in the console and to allow alerting thresholds. Rationale: by combining contextual sampling and priority-aware failure handling we get earlier detection of impactful regressions while keeping PR feedback signal-to-noise acceptable. Safety/permissions: the prober runs only in gated CI contexts by default and uses a sandboxed replay harness; no production data is stored by the prober. Backwards compatibility: default config keeps existing CI paths unchanged and enables the adapter only for teams opt-in in eval config. Testing: unit tests cover probe generation, scoring, and adapter decision logic; lightweight integration tests run in CI. Rollout: feature-flag gated and rolled out to nightly by default with a two-week observation window before enabling hard failures for high-priority prompts. See linked linear items for rollout checklist and metrics thresholds.
